target.title: fix(qa): Mantis before-after exits when a lane command stalls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QA operators running `openclaw qa mantis before-after` could have the entire before/after evidence run wait forever when a baseline or candidate lane command became silent. The first reachable command, `git worktree add`, and the later install, build, and QA commands had no stall detection or process-tree cleanup.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each Mantis lane command now uses the shared process runtime with a 10-minute inactivity watchdog. Output on either stdout or stderr resets the watchdog, so an active install or build has no total wall-clock cap; only a command that produces no output for the full interval is terminated. The timeout path also terminates the command's process tree. No CLI flag, config key, schema, dependency, or protocol surface is added.

The 10-minute silence budget leaves 8x headroom over the longest Discord scenario budget (75 seconds) while still bounding a genuinely stalled lane.

## User Impact

Mantis before/after runs can continue through long, active install/build/QA work, but now fail with a command-specific inactivity error instead of hanging indefinitely when a lane stops making progress. Descendant processes cannot remain behind after that failure.

## Evidence

The failure was reproduced against the original runner, then verified through the production entry with real parent/descendant processes, focused tests, and static boundary checks.

### Before-fix reproduction

The regression test was run against the original bare-`spawn` runner under an outer six-second deadline:

```text
$ timeout --foreground 6s node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
    extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts \
    -t 'stops a silent lane command'
exit=124

The test never settled before the outer deadline.
```

### After-fix real process-tree proof

This invoked the production `runMantisBeforeAfter` entry with a real executable `git` shim. Both the shim and its descendant ignored `SIGTERM` and stayed active until the inactivity path terminated their process group:

```text
[mantis inactivity proof] elapsed_ms=1373 error="git worktree add --detach -- <tmp>/.artifacts/qa-e2e/mantis/proof/worktrees/baseline baseline-ref produced no output for 1000ms" parent_alive=false descendant_alive=false
```

### Focused regression and adjacent CLI tests

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
    extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts \
    extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       64 passed (64)
```

### Shared inactivity contract

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/process/exec.no-output-timer.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       4 passed (4)
```

That shared suite proves stdout activity resets the watchdog, silent commands terminate as `no-output-timeout`, and the independent total-timeout behavior remains intact.

### Static and boundary checks

```text
$ oxfmt --check extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ oxlint extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.test.ts
exit=0

$ node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs
No extension plugin-sdk boundary violations found.
Baseline matches (0 entries).

$ git diff --check
exit=0
```

### Source and process-runtime contract audit

- Reachable entry chain: `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.ts:34` -> `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.runtime.ts:32` -> `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/run.runtime.ts:552` -> each `runLane` command.
- Owner boundary: QA Lab imports only the public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/process-runtime` and `number-runtime` facades; the extension boundary checker is green.
- Inactivity contract: `src/process/exec-runner.ts:212` arms the watchdog, and the stdout/stderr handlers at `src/process/exec-runner.ts:332` reset it after each output chunk.
- Process-tree contract: `src/process/exec-termination.ts:91` owns graceful and forced descendant cleanup. POSIX commands use a detached process group; Windows uses `taskkill /T`.
- Scenario budget: `extensions/qa-lab/src/live-transports/discord/discord-live.runtime.ts:287` defines the longest Discord scenario used here at 75 seconds.

The changed-surface classifier also passed its conflict-marker, changelog-attribution, formatting, Plugin SDK API baseline, deprecated-API, plugin-boundary, package-patch, and test-temp checks. Its full run stopped on an unrelated existing max-lines baseline in `src/cron/normalize.ts`. Extension typechecking was additionally blocked by three existing errors in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts`; neither file is changed by this PR.
